mechanism_narrative: The persistent narrowing of the workplace gap combined with higher grocery activity indicates broader daytime out-of-home recovery. That should continue to lift retail visits over the next four weeks as errands and shopping cluster around resumed commuting.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the prior four-week mean despite continued week-over-week improvement in WORKPLACES and GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: If residential time keeps easing while transit continues to recover, residents are spending more time outside the home and making more discretionary trips. That mix should raise retail-and-recreation mobility over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 8.5 and TRANSIT rises above -22 week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise within two weeks after RESIDENTIAL declines below 8.5 and TRANSIT improves past -22.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained improvement in parks use alongside transit recovery signals loosening mobility constraints and broader willingness to leave home. That should translate into higher retail traffic over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 28 days even though PARKS and TRANSIT both continue improving.

mechanism_narrative: When park mobility stops falling sharply and turns less negative, seasonal leisure demand is stabilizing. That stabilization should precede a modest retail rebound within one week as discretionary outings spill into shops and restaurants.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 1 point week-on-week after being below -35
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve in the week after PARKS rises from below -35.

mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in workplace mobility implies fewer in-person work trips and weaker weekday shopping spillovers. Over four weeks this should keep retail-and-recreation mobility below its recent average.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last four-week mean even though WORKPLACES remains depressed or falls further.

mechanism_narrative: If transit remains weak while residential time stays elevated, households are substituting toward home-based routines instead of retail trips. That substitution should suppress retail mobility over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -20 and RESIDENTIAL stays above 8 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within two weeks while TRANSIT stays below -20 and RESIDENTIAL stays above 8.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold improvement in grocery-pharmacy mobility indicates renewed errand density and more frequent neighborhood activity. Once that crosses back into positive territory, retail mobility should follow within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses above 0 and stays positive for two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior four-week mean within four weeks after GROCERY_PHARM turns and remains positive.

mechanism_narrative: The joint recovery of workplaces and transit should compound retail exposure because more commuters encounter shopping opportunities on trip chains. This interaction should lift retail mobility over the next four weeks, especially if both series keep improving together.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days despite simultaneous improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.
